rapport_notes: Genuinely accommodating — worked around the customer's packing/staging questions and full-house-pack pricing patiently over a long, detailed call.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Rep gives full quid pro quo ('let's get you quoted... ten to fifteen minutes... accurate quote') but never asks the actual concerns/agenda question afterward.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's practical packing questions (drawers, boxes) were answered directly but not framed as a Stage-1 concern the rep dug into with follow-ups.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: No Save-Your-Ass lines delivered; 'Would you like me to lock that in for you?' was asked and accepted for the virtual walkthrough date.

top_strength: Patiently walked through a full-house packing scenario, offering both full-pack and partial-pack (kitchen-only) pricing options on request.
coaching_note: Quid pro quo was delivered well, but the agenda question that should follow it was skipped — a missed chance to surface and dig into the packing/logistics concerns that surfaced anyway later, unprompted.
